title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: 為甚麼馬斯克要策劃 SpaceX 與特斯拉的超大型合併？
summary: 馬斯克稱，透過合併這兩家公司，「有很多好處可獲得」，而這將會是歷來規模最大的合併案。

title: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a $6B valuation
summary: Just 9 months after raising a $180 million seed round, Flapping Airplanes has landed a $1 billion Series A for its mission to build AI models "without ingesting half the internet."

title: Legal AI startup Legora raises $550M Series E at $8.8B valuation
summary: Legal AI startup Legora announced Wednesday that it raised a $550 million Series E round, valuing it at $8.8 billion.

title: Who Found the PHP Bug That Made Governments Unplug Their Websites? ChatGPT, Of Course
summary: OpenAI says its models found PHP2Shell and led a two-month coalition to fix it. It's the same AI that broke into Hugging Face and an Australian government portal this year.

title: How a SpaceX and Tesla Merger Would Reshape Musk’s AI Empire
summary: Both boards are now studying a tie-up that would put Grok, X, Starlink, orbital data centers, a chip megafactory and Optimus robots under one roof—and under one man's control.

title: PHP Armageddon: OpenAI, Google’s Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
summary: This is the kind of security issue that was found and prevented by AI, but is also a high risk because of AI.

title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C
summary: Blacksmith, a platform that lets companies build and test AI code more effectively, just announced a $66 million Series C round led by Sequoia that values the company at $1 billion.

title: Musk’s SpaceX-Tesla Merger Would Create a Bitcoin Treasury Behemoth
summary: Musk said both boards formed committees to weigh a tie-up that would combine Tesla’s 11,509 BTC and SpaceX’s 18,712 BTC—roughly $2.5 billion worth—onto a single balance sheet.

title: Bitcoin price tags $84.6K as US stocks head higher on SpaceX Q3 earnings beat
summary: Bitcoin extended gains to approach $85,000 after US stock markets reacted to higher-than-expected SpaceX earnings.

title: OpenAI Buys Orchestra Bio to Put AI Agents in Charge of Drug Development Grunt Work
summary: The ChatGPT maker is folding Orchestra’s drug-program agents into Rosalind, its life sciences suite, betting AI can shave time off the decade-plus it takes to bring a medicine to patients.

title: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs Join Growing List of Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
summary: Sixteen companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, up from nine just four days earlier, according to an updated public notice.
